card.text: Explore Mundilfari, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: A roughly nine-hour Cassini sequence provided Mundilfari’s elongation constraint and 6.74-hour rotation estimate. This ellipsoid uses assumed polar depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.43:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
